detail: Original upper seven bays were retained. The terra cotta frieze, iron faux balconies, substantial cornice, 120-foot promenade and historic ground alterations are documented. Archive plate N9863 is source confirmation.
Parks Canada designation identifies the retained historic cinema facade, vertical sign, central entry, tall round-headed windows and cornice.
Restoration architect describes retaining the 1919 cinema and adding service space to meet the current venue program.
Operator documents the 2012 restored venue, Donald Street frontage and current rooftop patio.
